title: Updating an Interior Tape Symbol
statement: Let $f: br	o	ext{Option}(S)$ be a tape, let $z$ be an integer, let $	ext{pre}$ and $	ext{rest}$ be finite words over a symbol set $S$, and let $a,b\in S$. If the tape is formed by storing $	ext{pre}\,a\,	ext{rest}$ starting at position $z$, then updating the cell at position $z+|	ext{pre}|$ to contain $b$ gives exactly the tape formed by storing $	ext{pre}\,b\,	ext{rest}$ starting at $z$, with the original tape retained outside the stored segment.
hypotheses_covered: Tape f from integers to optional symbols
Finite words pre and rest over S
Symbols a and b in S
